title: Aero-Together-SMP
description: This Server is all about Aeronautics as well as Create and a few Create Addons that are nice to have
body:
The Official Modpack for the Aero-Together-SMP.
This Pack adds for example Create Aeronautics, Create, Farmers Delight, as well as a lot of important amd Nice-to-have Create addons. As soon as Create: Linear Motion is available, we will add it to the Server
NOTE: You need to join the Discord Server to get Whitelisted
